title: Serialize concurrent Windows updates and preserve every published v0.2.216 safety fix.
changes: Prevent simultaneous managed Windows npm install/update processes from replacing the same executable and package tree using a safe per-prefix lock, preserving existing owners and failing closed on incomplete or unknown locks.
Ship the exact Windows cross-process update-lock regression in the public client release source and native Windows CI.
Preserve the v0.2.216 independent Windows Scheduled Task update handoff, bounded desktop snapshot probes, correct process listing headers and published macOS trusted-parent-symlink behavior.
Retain the v0.2.215 deferred telemetry restart command behavior and the established first-party pinned client/runtime release pair.
